title: How Do Content Producers Respond to Engagement on Social Media Platforms?
authors: Simha Mummalaneni; Hema Yoganarasimhan; Varad V Pathak
eligible_reason: Large-scale Twitter field experiment that randomly boosts engagement; OLS on the randomized boost, 2SLS and DML-IV (EconML) of producer activity on engagement received. Single randomized intervention, no staggered adoption.
design_notes: replication-analysis notebook: Table 5 smf.ols(t_engagement_recd ~ boost), Table 6 IV2SLS with boost as instrument, heterogeneous effects with econml DMLIV. One row per user (before/treatment/after aggregates).
data_files_note: 10% sample with added noise and some demographics removed (README).
data_provenance_note: Noise added to a 10% sample; results not identical to the paper.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ empty for this suffix); screened from README, code, data and the OpenAlex abstract. Out of scope.
